title: Poor Customer Service and Unresolved Issues – Mashreq Bank
body:
am extremely disappointed with the poor service I have experienced with Mashreq Bank. I have been trying for a long time to contact and receive assistance from the customer service team, but without success.

I personally visited two main Mashreq branches, yet no one was able to assist me with:

Clearing the blocked amount of AED 3, and
Cancelling/removing my active credit card application, which I no longer require.

Because of this unresolved issue, I am unable to obtain a No Liability Letter, which is urgently required.

Despite multiple visits to the branches, I was repeatedly advised to contact customer service. However, no support was provided to help me reach customer service, and I have made several phone call attempts without receiving any response or resolution.

This situation has caused unnecessary stress and inconvenience. I sincerely hope this complaint is reviewed seriously and that I receive a clear explanation and prompt resolution to my issues at the earliest.

I am waiting for a reasoned response and proper assistance from Mashreq Bank.

I’ll not recommend anyone to open acount with them. Save your money & time…totally tension & tension.

title: Credit Card Dispute
body:
I recently had a dispute on my Mashreq credit card, and honestly, I was not expecting that the outcome would come in my favour. To my surprise, Mashreq Bank stood by me and helped me get my money back.

The Dispute Resolution Unit was efficient, transparent, and proactive in keeping me informed throughout the process. Not only was the case resolved positively, but the refund was processed smoothly and without delays.

I cannot thank Mashreq enough for their support, professionalism, and excellent customer service. This experience has truly built my trust in the bank.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a reliable bank that genuinely values its customers.

title: Overall app and the service - Horrible
body: I have been banking with Mashreq for over three years, and the digital experience has consistently been disappointing. While the bank promotes itself as a digital-first institution, the reality is far from it. The app frequently shows inaccurate data, features do not function reliably, and customers are often redirected to digital channels that are themselves broken. There is virtually no real-time support — inquiries take an average of six days to receive a response, and there is no one easily available to speak with. As a customer, this has been an incredibly frustrating and exhausting experience. A truly digital bank must deliver both seamless functionality and responsive support Mashreq currently delivers neither.

title: Not Just Promises. Real Support
body:
Mashreq Bank was the first bank that truly believed in me when no one else did.
They gave me my first debit card despite a low salary, my first chequebook when I needed it for a rental contract, my first credit card when no other bank would approve me — and now, my first personal loan, even when my profile wasn’t “perfect.”
While other banks were overly strict, Mashreq saw potential, understood my situation, and gave me a real chance.
Forever thankful for the trust and support. 🙏
#MashreqBank #ThankYouMashreq #Gratitude #FirstSteps #RealSupport

title: Disappointing Experience with New Face Verification Feature
body:
I’ve been a loyal user of Mashreq Bank’s mobile app, but my recent experience with the newly introduced 6-digit PIN registration and face verification feature has been extremely frustrating.

After logging in, I was forced to set up the new 6-digit PIN, supposedly for added security and fraud prevention. However, to complete this, I had to go through the face verification process. I followed all instructions carefully — removed my glasses, ensured there was no background obstruction, and used proper lighting — but still couldn’t verify my identity.

The most frustrating part? I urgently needed to register a beneficiary to transfer money, and the app wouldn’t allow me to proceed without completing the face verification. It turned a simple, urgent task into a nightmare.

It’s clear this feature wasn’t properly tested before release. Please take user experience seriously — especially for something as critical as banking. I strongly urge Mashreq to review their QA process, bring in skilled testers, and avoid outsourcing without thorough quality checks. Security is important, but not at the cost of usability.

I hope this is addressed immediately. No customer should have to go through this level of frustration.
